subject: Incremental uplift & phased renewal — onboarding timeline and QBR options
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@lumenops.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@lumenops.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Incremental uplift & phased renewal — onboarding timeline and QBR options

Hi Sanjay / Priya —

Thanks again for the productive discussion last week. As we head into your renewal window (term ends 2027-07-31), I wanted to kick off a short plan to make the renewal and the planned incremental uplift as low-friction as possible. High level: LumenOps is targeting a phased increase (20% Q3, additional 30% Q4) and a 12‑month term reset.

Proposed quick agenda for a 30–45m kickoff:
- Review current usage and headroom (attached usage export)
- Confirm uplift phasing and milestone dates
- Mutual action plan (MAP) deliverables and owners (I attached a v1)
- QBR scheduling and exec attendees
- Procurement/timing for contract amendment

Immediate asks from your side:
1) Confirm the procurement contact we should send the DocuSign to (name + email).
2) Which of these QBR slots works for your team (PST): Tue Jun 8 10:00–10:45, Wed Jun 9 14:00–14:45, Fri Jun 11 09:00–09:45. I can send a calendar invite once you confirm.
3) Any legal redlines we should expect on the amendment (e.g., data retention, SLAs)? If yes, please flag the appropriate people so we can loop them in early.

Attachments: 20270523-MAP-v1.pdf (MAP draft), lumenops-usage-APR-2027.csv (usage snapshot). I’ll follow up internally to loop our legal and solutions engineering as needed — Kimberly will lead procurement facilitation and Marissa will prepare an exec readiness slide for the QBR.

Thanks — looking forward to your confirmation.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com


From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@lumenops.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@lumenops.com>, LumenOps Procurement <procurement@lumenops.com>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 12:02:31 -0700
Subject: Re: Incremental uplift & phased renewal — onboarding timeline and QBR options

On Sun, May 23, 2027 at 9:14 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Sanjay / Priya —
> 
> Thanks again for the productive discussion last week. As we head into your renewal window (term ends 2027-07-31), I wanted to kick off a short plan to make the renewal and the planned incremental uplift as low-friction as possible.

Thanks Karthik — this looks good. We (LumenOps) are aligned with a phased approach and the proposed cadence. A couple of quick items from our side:

- Procurement contact: Priya Shah (priya.shah@lumenops.com) — she’s cc’d.
- Prefer the Wed Jun 9 14:00 PST slot for the kickoff QBR.
- We’ll need ballpark pricing tiers for the 20% and 50% uplift scenarios before the meeting so Procurement can kick internal approvals. Can you add a per-token and per-embedding delta for the uplift tiers plus any discounts that apply for committing to a 12‑month term?
- For legal: our GC flagged two items — (1) sample amendment language on data residency and (2) standard SLAs for dedicated throughput. I’ll share specifics by Tuesday.

If you can send the calendar invite for Jun 9 and the short pricing table (even a slide/image is fine), we’ll circulate internally.

Regards,
Sanjay Rao
Head of ML Platform, LumenOps
sanjay@lumenops.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555‑0182

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Incremental uplift & phased renewal — onboarding timeline and QBR options

Team — looping you both for quick coordination. Sanjay confirmed Wed Jun 9 14:00 PST as the kickoff QBR and Priya is the procurement contact. Actions: 

Kimberly
- Can you draft an amendment template and a short pricing delta table for the two uplift scenarios (20% / 50%)? They specifically asked for per-token and per-embedding deltas and any volume discounts for a 12‑month commit. A one-slide summary + a short pricing memo is enough. Target: Tue EOD (May 25) so Karthik can share before the meeting.

Marissa
- Please prepare an exec slide (single page) showing current baseline, proposed phased uplift timeline (Q3/Q4), and value metrics (cost per 1M tokens, projected noop savings from caching). Also add a one‑slide runbook for the kickoff: attendees, goals, and the mutual action plan owners. Target: Wed EOD (May 26) so we can iterate.

Also - Priya mentioned legal flags. If you think we need legal involved before Tue, say so — otherwise we’ll collect their asks and run redlines in the first week after the kickoff.

I’m attaching the MAP v1 and usage snapshot so you have context.

Thanks — I’ll send the calendar invite to LumenOps once we have Kimberly’s pricing memo.

Best,
Karthik

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@lumenops.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@lumenops.com>, LumenOps Procurement <procurement@lumenops.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Incremental uplift & phased renewal — onboarding timeline and QBR options

On Mon, May 24, 2027 at 8:07 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team — looping you both for quick coordination. Sanjay confirmed Wed Jun 9 14:00 PST as the kickoff QBR and Priya is the procurement contact.

Thanks everyone — confirmed on our side. A couple of notes ahead of Jun 9 kickoff: 
- We’ll circulate internal stakeholders (finance + ops) once we have the pricing memo from Kimberly — procurement wants a clear delta table and a sample amendment (prefer PDF).
- Our GC will send the two redline bullets Sanjay mentioned by Tue EOD (May 25) — attaching a short note for context.
- Pre-read request: can you provide the projected per-day token curve for the uplift scenarios (we want to model monthly cash flow)? If you can’t, a high‑level projection by tier is fine.

We’ll see you on Jun 9. Please include a DocuSign link in the follow-up if there’s an amendment ready for signature.

Best,
Priya Shah
Sr. Procurement Manager, LumenOps
priya.shah@lumenops.com
